title: skills: the ask-data skill says what the client does after the user answers an ask-back
body:
epic:#34659#1 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjMnXJdSZifpEN5i7aU

Filing gate: ④ a child of the cross-lane parent #34659 (the 「MCP 二期与问数」 epic), filed on the maintainer's word in this session's chat, 2026-11-17, verbatim: 「立卡」, answering this session's list of four gaps nobody had carded. The gap was reported by the dispatching seat `repo:objectstack#3` on #34659 (comment 6960624063, item 2); the filer did not re-read the code behind it.

## Why

The skill tells a client to ask which reading is meant and stops there. After the person answers, the client has no instruction: compute the chosen candidate through the governed route, or fall back. Left open, each client decides for itself.

## Evidence

- Per the report: the ADR-0149 D3 note states the step after the answer; neither `skills/objectstack-ask/SKILL.md` nor #34868 does.

## Scope

- One row in the skill, in the ADR note's words: the candidate the user names is then asked for by its exact name and answered through `query_dataset`; a user who names none of them gets the fallback, labelled.
- The served `/mcp/skill` text follows (single source). One eval case for the second turn.

## Done when

- A two-turn ask (ambiguous word, then the user's choice) ends in a governed answer citing the chosen measure.

## Relations

- Parent: #34659. Related: #34868, #34996 (the skill iteration loop may carry this change; then close this card as carried).
- Governed surface: `skills/**`.
